meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Zec.6.10; also called Helem at Zec.6.14;
Also named: che.lem (חֵ֫לֶם "Helem" H2494)
§ Heldai = "worldly"
1) one of David's mighty warriors and the 12th captain of the monthly courses for the temple service
2) a returning exile in the time of Zechariah

elsewhere.note: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
